messages:
marco: Quick QA/design sync. Found two small but visible issues in the model catalog compare: 1) filter chips remain highlighted after toggling compare off, 2) the performance badge tooltip text is inconsistent across themes.

lina: Repro steps for the chips: apply filters, open compare, deselect all, then click 'All models' in side nav. The chips still look selected even when list shows everything. Might be CSS class state leakage.

sam: For badges: in dark theme tooltip uses white text on pale yellow and is unreadable at small sizes. We need to standardize tooltip style or use accessible tokens.

marco: Microcopy suggestion: badge label 'Perf' -> change to 'Latency' and show unit 'ms' on hover. That's clearer and avoids the 'perf tier' confusion.

lina: Accessibility fix: when compare drawer opens, move focus to drawer close button so keyboard users can tab into the content predictably. Also add aria-modal=true when drawer open to trap focus.

dev-bot: Note: drawer is currently implemented as role=dialog but lacks aria-modal. Add role=dialog aria-modal=true and ensure inert is applied to background.

sam: Design decision: for pinned version UI, using the same pin icon for 'pin list' vs 'pin version' is confusing. Propose using a bookmark icon for pinned versions and annotate with small text 'pinned'.

marco: Also propose adding a small inline legend above compare table: "Latency measured at 512 tokens; lower is better." that appears on first open so users understand badge meaning.

lina: Button order in row actions: currently pin appears last; move it earlier to make it discoverable. Keep keyboard order consistent with visual order.

sam: Will update Figma with tooltip color tokens and the bookmark icon. Also add a11y contrast checks.

marco: Action items: Sam to update Figma tokens + icon (due Fri). Lina to add aria-modal to drawer and update focus behavior (due Thu). Dev-bot to add a unit test that ensures chips visual state resets on view change (due Wed).

marco: Thanks, let's prioritize the chip visual bug and badge tooltip fix for the next patch.
